title: Torch2Chip: An End-to-end Customizable Deep Neural Network Compression and Deployment Toolkit for Prototype Hardware Accelerator Design
problem: Deploying neural networks to custom hardware accelerators requires integrated optimization, compression, and compilation steps that are not unified. Practitioners lack end-to-end tooling for compressing models and mapping them to prototype accelerator specifications.
motivation: Custom hardware accelerators offer significant performance and energy benefits, but the fragmented toolchain for compression, deployment, and hardware-specific optimization prevents rapid prototyping and deployment.
method: Torch2Chip takes PyTorch neural network models and automatically makes them smaller through compression techniques: quantization (using fewer bits to represent numbers) and sparsity optimization (removing unnecessary connections). It then converts these compressed models into hardware-specific code that maps each operation in the network to the right resources on the target accelerator.
key_novelty: Torch2Chip integrates neural network compression, compilation, and hardware mapping into a single customizable toolkit for deploying PyTorch models to custom accelerators.
contributions: End-to-end PyTorch-to-hardware compilation pipeline for custom accelerators
Customizable neural network compression with quantization and sparsity optimization
Hardware-aware mapping and optimization for accelerator design
Rapid prototyping toolkit for hardware accelerator evaluation and deployment
limitations: Not discussed in title; specific performance metrics, hardware platforms evaluated, and comparative results not available without abstract.
primary_theme: End-to-end toolkit for deploying compressed neural networks to custom hardware accelerators
